content.title: Chapter 42 - FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION — Sec. 42-76. - I.F.C. Section 907.5.2.2, Emergency voice/alarm communication.
content.summary:
Section 907.5.2.2 Emergency voice/alarm communication,
is hereby amended by adding the following subsection:
"907.5.2.2.6. Intelligibility.
The intelligibility of a voice/alarm communication system shall be tested in an objective
                  manner in accordance with NFPA 72."

faqs.q: Sec. 42-76. - I.F.C. Section 907.5.2.2, Emergency voice/alarm communication.
faqs.a:
Section 907.5.2.2 Emergency voice/alarm communication,
is hereby amended by adding the following subsection:
"907.5.2.2.6. Intelligibility.
The intelligibility of a voice/alarm communication system shall be tested in an objective
                  manner in accordance with NFPA 72."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
